reviews.text: So I don't come here often but every time I do come here, one of the first things I see are the beta fishes. They are ALWAYS in very poor conditions. Some even dead in their containers. This store literally has sickly / dead fishes on display because they don't take care of them. Stop selling them if y'all can't even take care of them. I am requesting that someone from PetSmart Corporate or the District Manager contact me immediately regarding an extremely unprofessional experience I had at one of your stores this evening.

I have been shopping with PetSmart for years, and I am extremely upset and disappointed with how I was treated.

I arrived at approximately 8:50 PM. The posted store hours state that the location closes at 9:00 PM, so the store was still supposed to be open. However, the doors were already closed.

What was especially frustrating was that the employee allowed another customer to enter immediately before me. I was right behind that customer, yet I was refused entry.

When I attempted to address the situation with the employee, instead of professionally explaining why I was not being allowed inside, she LAUGHED at me and WALKED AWAY.

That behavior was disrespectful, dismissive, and completely unacceptable customer service. Regardless of the reason for refusing entry, I should not have been laughed at and walked away from when I was simply trying to enter a store during its posted business hours.

I also work in this shopping center, so I am very familiar with the businesses and their operating hours. I understand that employees have closing responsibilities, but customers should not be turned away at 8:50 PM when the posted closing time is 9:00 PM—especially when another customer was allowed inside directly in front of me.

I am requesting that management review any available security footage from approximately 8:45–9:00 PM. The footage should show the other customer being allowed inside, me attempting to enter immediately afterward, and the employee’s interaction with me.

After being a customer for years, I am extremely disappointed that I was treated this way. I would like this complaint formally documented and escalated to the Store Manager and District Manager.

I am requesting that someone from PetSmart Corporate or the District Manager contact me directly as soon as possible regarding how this incident will be addressed.

Thank you,

Jessica Vega
